text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, did you hear?
You know, about that mock race this weekend.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the one Narita Taishin is running in.
I heard it's meant to re-evaluate her potential, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Winning Ticket shouting about it all across the academy day after day,
word of the mock race had spread far and wide.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, the buzz around it was—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You've got the precise tactician Biwa Hayahide, and the explosive Winning Ticket.
The other runners have all been making rapid progress, too...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, the outcome seems pretty clear. ...More than that,
I just hope she doesn't push herself too hard and end up getting hurt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Narita Taishin looking down with a grim expression, I instinctively call out to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They seem to be quite close, so she's likely the one who understands
the true strength of Biwa Hayahide and Winning Ticket better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin's expression remains stiff. But in my mind,
her breathtaking late kick from that race footage is still burned clear—
choice_data_list: ...You don't need to get dragged into the battle for position.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Who asked you, know-it-all?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You're telling me to just do nothing and lose because it looks bad...!?
choice_data_list: No, because doing that is how you'll win!
No, doing that is how you win!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, what?
choice_data_list: Bide your strength in the early stretch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Like that'll... But, if someone huge like Hayahide
pulls way ahead and runs away with it...!
choice_data_list: When it comes to late kick sharpness, you won't lose to anyone!
When it comes to finishing speed, no one can beat you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously, what is your deal...
You make no sense, and you're way too intense...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I don't know if I truly got through to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so—the starting gates open.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—CLANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... Biwa Hayahide's setting a great pace.
She's found herself a prime spot in the front pack.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket looks in high spirits today too, probably since so many familiar faces are running! I can't wait for the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Narita Taishin is so far back...
Did she botch her start, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(...Damn it, I'm panicking. The space ahead is getting boxed in...
It looks like a wall...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (But—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ("There's no need to get caught up in the scuffle for position.")

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ("Save your strength during the early stretch.")

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ("No—it's because running that way will let you win!")

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ("No—it's because running that way will let you win!")

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ("When it comes to that razor-sharp final kick, you won't lose to anyone!!")

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ("When it comes to that razor-sharp final kick, you won't lose to anyone!!")

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Gah, give me a break.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes, the fourth corner...! 
Ah, Winning Ticket is making her move!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Doryaaaaaaahhhhhh!!
FULL! THROTTLE! DASHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh, precisely as calculated, Winning Ticket...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and Winning Ticket!
Is this really coming down to a showdown between the top two...?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: —! No, on the outside...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin...?! 
W-What unbelievable burst in that final kick?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(That's right, don't just stand there, don't look away!
Look at me! Look at me!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (I am—a racer, a horsegirl... Narita Taishin!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaggghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was even sharper than what I'd seen on video...
A bona fide razor's edge forged by unyielding perseverance and will.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Claiming victory in a photo finish that left the crowd breathless was Narita Taishin.
Biwa Hayahide and Winning Ticket crossed the line right behind her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It had been an incredible race—one that fully demonstrated
the boundless potential held by the horsegirl known as Narita Taishin...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...It seems I still have a lot to learn as a trainer.
To think I misjudged someone of your caliber—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaaaaarrrrgggghhhh!!
I'm so frikkiiiinnnn' frustrated!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Stop that.
Your shouting right after a race is seriously giving me a headache.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But, but, but! —I gave it everything I had!
Just like always, I was gonna win for sure!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And yet... I still couldn't catch you!!
My heart is totally on fire right now...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So!! Next time, for sure, for sure, absolutely, positively foooorrrrr suuuuure!!
Let's go all out in a race again, Taishin!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ticket—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
......Haha.
You're too loud, so no way, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...It seems the message behind our entry reached you after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Losing a worthy rival at this stage was something we couldn't overlook.
...That is all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...You guys are so corny.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was after that when Narita Taishin walked over to me
with somewhat hesitant steps.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ticket beat you to the punch the other day.
...So say it now. You know... that thing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not that!! Stupid, you want me to kick you?!
I mean the OTHER thing...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. ...Looking forward to working with you.
